title: Design System: ZWLY Lab — Vibe Coding Portfolio

motion.name: quick-feedback
motion.purpose: Local color, opacity, and press feedback.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Underlines, borders, disclosures, and image state changes.

motion.name: retained-preview
motion.purpose: Native geometry transition with top-left origin; interruptions measure visible bounds before cancellation.

motion.name: process-spotlight
motion.purpose: Moves and scales the fixed process annotation without changing its base left or width.

motion.name: route-title-reveal
motion.purpose: One coordinated entry: summary follows after 40ms, home overview after 80ms; interaction and route cleanup cancel it.

motion.name: linked-title-underline
motion.purpose: Reveals a one-pixel title underline on linked-card hover and keyboard focus.

motion.name: preview-image-zoom
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer hover and keyboard-focus feedback for work, note, poster, and overview preview images.

motion.name: visual-print-view-reveal
motion.value: view(); entry 15% entry 100%; inset(8% 6%) to inset(0)
motion.purpose: Native CSS scroll reveal for the two homepage visual-print images, with a static unsupported-browser fallback.

motion.name: gallery-departure
motion.purpose: Image, panel, controls and backdrop leave together; changed artwork fades and unchanged artwork returns to its visible opener.

motion.name: gallery-arrival
motion.purpose: A stable original-ratio frame carries the loaded thumbnail until the full image arrives; navigation uses 300ms.

components.name: Primary Demo Action
components.description: Opens or closes the embedded interactive demo.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: #fff; font: 400 16px/1.45 var(--font-archivo), 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity var(--motion-quick) ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover, .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { opacity: .85; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 6px; } .ds-button-primary:active { opacity: .7; }

components.name: Editorial Text Link
components.description: Routes readers into a project, collection, or full demo.
components.html: 浏览作品集
components.css: .ds-text-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; width: fit-content; padding: 10px 0; color: var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font: 400 16px/1.45 var(--font-archivo), 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-text-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 -1px; height: 1px; background: var(--accent); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-arrive); } .ds-text-link svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; transition: transform 160ms ease; } .ds-text-link:hover, .ds-text-link:focus-visible { color: var(--accent); } .ds-text-link:hover::after, .ds-text-link:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-text-link:hover svg { transform: translate(2px, -2px); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 6px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-text-link::after, .ds-text-link svg { transition: none; } .ds-text-link:hover svg { transform: none; } }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Compact editorial navigation with green active and focus states.
components.html: 首页作品手记关于
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 32px; align-items: center; font: 400 16px/1.45 var(--font-archivo), 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding: 12px 0; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 -1px; height: 1px; background: var(--accent); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-arrive); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--accent); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a:focus-visible::after, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page']::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 6px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav a::after { transition: none; } }

components.name: Direction Choices
components.description: Four accessible text controls switch the hero among mixed, interactive, application, and visual work.
components.css: .ds-directions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px 28px; } .ds-directions button { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: 400 13px/1.5 var(--font-archivo), 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-directions button:hover, .ds-directions button:focus-visible, .ds-directions button[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--accent); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); } .ds-directions button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 6px; }

components.name: Work Card
components.description: A flat project entry that leads with title and description, followed by category and status metadata.
components.html: JD · 本地任务控制台围绕真实任务组织界面与操作路径。应用界面 · 成果展示
components.css: .ds-work-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; color: var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color var(--motion-standard) ease, opacity var(--motion-quick) ease; } .ds-work-media { display: block; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; background: var(--footer); border: 1px solid var(--line); transition: border-color var(--motion-standard) ease; } .ds-work-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; padding: 22px 0; } .ds-work-body small { color: var(--muted); font: 400 13px/1.5 var(--font-archivo), 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .035em; } .ds-work-body strong { font: 500 27px/1.4 var(--font-archivo), 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.035em; transition: color var(--motion-quick) ease; } .ds-work-body > span { color: var(--muted); font: 400 16px/1.8 var(--font-archivo), 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-work-card:hover, .ds-work-card:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-work-card:hover .ds-work-media, .ds-work-card:focus-visible .ds-work-media { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-work-card:hover strong, .ds-work-card:focus-visible strong { color: var(--accent); } .ds-work-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 8px; } .ds-work-card:active { opacity: .78; }

components.name: Note Card
components.description: A media-first note entry that places type and date after the title and summary.
components.html: 为理解而动一次运动应该解释一次真实的状态变化。构建记录 · 2026.10.12
components.css: .ds-note-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; padding-bottom: 28px; color: var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color var(--motion-standard) ease, opacity var(--motion-quick) ease; } .ds-note-media { display: block; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; background: var(--footer); border: 1px solid var(--line); transition: border-color var(--motion-standard) ease; } .ds-note-card strong { font: 500 27px/1.4 var(--font-archivo), 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.035em; transition: color var(--motion-quick) ease; } .ds-note-card > span:not(.ds-note-media) { color: var(--muted); font: 400 16px/1.8 var(--font-archivo), 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-note-card small { color: var(--muted); font: 400 13px/1.5 var(--font-archivo), 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .035em; } .ds-note-card time { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-note-card:hover, .ds-note-card:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-note-card:hover .ds-note-media, .ds-note-card:focus-visible .ds-note-media { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-note-card:hover strong, .ds-note-card:focus-visible strong { color: var(--accent); } .ds-note-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 8px; } .ds-note-card:active { opacity: .78; }

narrative.overview:
The site presents Vibe Coding as a considered body of finished and in-progress work. Its white editorial field, charcoal type, restrained forest-green emphasis, fine rules, and generous whitespace keep real interfaces and original artwork ahead of decorative effects.

The world is quiet but active: selection, disclosure, and gallery motion explain a state change and then settle. It avoids avatars, fake consoles, invented metrics, ambient particles, and decorative device renders. Claims stay attached to visible work and explicit evidence boundaries.
keyCharacteristics: Light editorial surfaces with forest-green interaction emphasis.
Real applications, interactive experiments, and original visual work share one collection.
Stable media geometry and native controls make state changes legible.
Chinese-first copy uses self-hosted Archivo with system Chinese fallbacks.

rules.name: The Green as Evidence Rule
rules.body: Use green to show selection, focus, or a meaningful route into the work; it is not a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Canonical Color Rule
rules.body: The frontmatter hex values are the normative runtime colors. Tonal ramps in `.impeccable/design.json` are optional synthesized UI-editor preview metadata, not application tokens.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Keep Archivo and the established Chinese fallbacks across display, body, labels, and controls; create hierarchy with the existing scale rather than introducing another typeface.

rules.name: The Flat by Default Rule
rules.body: Keep surfaces flat at rest; use rules, spacing, and tonal fields to express structure.

rules.name: The Identity Before Metadata Rule
rules.body: Put the work or note title and its summary before category, status, note type, date, or technology metadata.

dos: Do lead with real interfaces, operable demos, original visual work, and clearly labeled historical or exploratory material.
Do keep the white, charcoal, forest-green, Archivo, fine-rule, and generous-whitespace identity across new surfaces.
Do preserve keyboard states, native dialog focus and Escape behavior, interruptible selection motion, and immediate reduced-motion updates.
Do keep source references in `docs/design-references.md` and reuse notices in `licenses/`.
Do treat desktop and mobile rendering, demo ready/error states, rapid image changes, gallery focus restoration, and reduced motion as verification boundaries.
donts: Don't invent roles, prompts, metrics, clients, testimonials, or completed outcomes that the visible work cannot support.
Don't add an avatar, fake console, ambient particle background, autoplay, or decorative device mockup.
Don't replace distinct phone, desktop, visual-series, and reading proportions with one uniform media box.
Don't treat reference-site permission as permission to reuse external articles or media.
